verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's marketing copy says it offers 'automations' and 'Enhanced automations', and Analytics AI refers to automations as a product feature, but the pack has no documentation of a rule or trigger builder. The documented event mechanism is webhooks (message events such as open, click and bounce, plus subscription changes) and inbound routes, which let your own application respond in a way you define; Marketing webhooks also require the Standard or Premium plan. Missing for 10: documented native trigger-condition-action rule definition, detail on which events can trigger automations, AI-native or natural-language rule authoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.
